one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event in the window: Q4 FY2026 results Thursday 2026-11-19 after the close, call 4:30pm ET (company release 2026-10-29; the Earnings Whispers 11-17 date was wrong), with first FY2027 commentary. Base rates: revenue beat the guide midpoint 10/10 quarters (median +2.65% over the last 8) and non-GAAP EPS beat 10/10 (median +7.1%), so a beat (drivers 3.43 / whisper 3.61 vs guide 3.34-3.40) is expected and largely priced; post-print reactions have been two-sided (Feb 2026 up ~14% after hours on the guide, Aug 2026 -11.7% for the week despite a big beat on supply caution). The stock fell 20.8% from Oct 6 to Oct 30 in an AI-hardware de-rating with no company headline; short-horizon reversal after a sharp drop is a small positive. Net: median ~$305 (+0.5%), log sigma 13.5% (45%/3.5 = 12.9% plus a little for the print), roughly symmetric. The print date change keeps it inside the window, so the ladder is unchanged. FOMC (Dec 9-10) falls after the window.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM ex-SBC EPS at 2027-11-02 from the approved driver build (FY2028-weighted NOPAT + after-tax interest on ~$2.0B net cash, 171.3M shares) ~$16.14 x 21.2x (= 23.2x on SBC-costed EPS $14.74; SBC-costed 4-peer median 23.7x, own 23.9x, k=0.8, -0.7 turn post-horizon risk)

inputs_detail.value: 21.2x NTM on the build's ex-SBC EPS (= 23.2x SBC-costed)
inputs_detail.derivation: Peers on one SBC-costed NTM basis: VIAV 28.21/18.8 = $1.50 Zacks EPS (non-GAAP, excludes SBC per Ex.99.1) less SBC 55.4/261.0 = $0.212 x 0.85 = $0.18 -> $1.32 -> 21.4x; RAL 21.26x (adjusted EPS keeps SBC, Ex.99.1); AME 26.0x (peers.md; adjusted EPS excludes amortization only); Anritsu 28.5x (IFRS, SBC costed). Median (21.4, 21.3, 26.0, 28.5) = (21.4+26.0)/2 = 23.7x. KEYS own: FY27 (= NTM from Nov-2026) non-GAAP consensus 13.93 less SBC 3.0% x 8,210 x 0.86 / 171 = $1.24 -> $12.69; 303.5/12.69 = 23.9x. Exit = 23.7 x (23.9/23.7)^0.8 = 23.86x; less 0.7 turn post-horizon risk (long_dated_risks: optics digestion 0.30 x -3 = -0.90, later China rule 0.15 x -1.5 = -0.225, 3.2T/6G upside 0.30 x +1.5 = +0.45; net -0.675) = 23.2x SBC-costed. Engine P/E reads ex-SBC NTM EPS at the horizon (~$16.14); KEYS NTM SBC 3.0% x ~9,312 x 0.86 / 171.3 = $1.40, so costed EPS $14.74 and ratio 14.74/16.14 = 0.913; 23.2 x 0.913 = 21.2x.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$210 (-31%) the market would be pricing ~14.2x the build's SBC-costed NTM horizon EPS ($14.74), i.e. an AI-optics order rollover (book-to-bill below 1 after Q3's 1.13), a China entity-list/retaliation event, or margins back to FY24-25 levels; it sits just under the 2026 breakout level (Jan 2026 close $216) and ~9% above the downside case ($193). A -20% move alone is not a break: KEYS has had two -20% legs in 2026 already.

reverse_dcf_check: 23.2x SBC-costed NTM P/E at the horizon (a 4.3% earnings yield) at a ~9% cost of equity implies ~5% perpetual earnings growth after FY2029 with segment margins held ~33-34%; plausible only if AI/6G test stays structural, and at the pre-AI ~26% non-GAAP margin the same price needs ~6.5% growth, which is why the mid-cycle leg keeps 30% and the multiple carries a -0.7 turn post-horizon deduction.

sbc_treatment.note: FY25 SBC $162M (10-K), TTM $214M (3.0-3.1% of revenue). Counted once, as a cost: the horizon P/E is set on SBC-costed EPS (peers on the same basis: VIAV converted from ex-SBC, RAL/AME/Anritsu already cost SBC) and translated onto the engine's ex-SBC EPS by KEYS's own ratio 0.913 (NTM SBC $1.40/share after tax). The share path (-0.8%/yr) is the reported diluted count net of buybacks and issuance, the same diluted-share basis the peers' EPS uses; no separate dilution charge. The mid-cycle leg uses SBC-costed EPS. The engine set keeps sbc_treatment 'dilution' only so the net-cash bridge does not deduct non-cash SBC.
